purpose: Document and audit the existing outcome-independent fallback fading used for sparse local fertility and mortality age cells.
formula: smoothstep(exposure) × smoothstep(expected events); applied as local-cell weight around the municipality/FA general factor
requiredChecks: weight is monotonic in exposure and expected events
near-zero information yields zero local weight
strong information can yield 100 percent local weight
threshold constants match the production builder
localized fertility with fading retains its existing passed rolling-origin gate
localized mortality with fading retains its existing passed rolling-origin gate
governance: Thresholds are not to be tuned against already-consumed forecast outcomes.
Fading is only a fallback where an official Raps parameter is unavailable.
Any future replacement must be pre-declared and compared without altering the existing production evidence.
